name: Setup command runs in a newly created worktree
description: A command Cursor runs inside a worktree it has just created. Creation follows an explicit user action, so this is not silent-on-open, but the payload is committed configuration that then runs on the user's machine with no prompt of its own. A string value is the path of a script resolved against the config file; an array declares shell commands run in sequence, and the provenance key says which form declared the value.
message: Worktree setup runs a committed command when a worktree is created
